description.content: Props for the Workspace rendered into a popout window (see PopoutWindows.render).
The popout window is closed once its workspace has no tabs left (e.g. its last tab is dragged back to the main window); if the Workspace needs its own onModelChanged prop, call this one from it.
Closes the popout window once its workspace has no tabs left
Used to read the popout's current model (e.g. when it's closed)
